title: Ranger Bill
paragraphs: A family adventure series centered on Ranger Bill Jefferson and his team as they handle rescues, wilderness emergencies, crime, and moral challenges, produced by the Moody Bible Institute.

Moody Bible Institute Christian family-adventure drama centered on forest ranger Bill Jefferson in Knotty Pine. Frozen GRH snapshot has 218 playable objects; 77 catalog rows lack dates, with one exact date recovered additively from RadioGOLDINdex. Some general references extend production to 1964, while specialist chronology ends its dated run in May 1962.

GRH documents the program through Local WMBI 15-minute era (October 2, 1950 to April 13, 1954) on [[org|org.52b7244a632bcbda|WMBI]] and Thirty-minute Moody syndication era (April 14, 1954 to May 19, 1962) on [[org|org.52b7244a632bcbda|WMBI]].
The program is also connected in the archive to [[org|org.33ebafaa69470671|Moody Bible Institute]] (syndicated by) and [[org|org.52b7244a632bcbda|WMBI]] (originated at station).

Its indexed subjects and listening characteristics include forestry and ranger work, transportation emergencies, wildlife encounters, wilderness rescue and protection, youth responsibility and growing up, and fire prevention and wildfire danger.

GRH also places the series in documented historical contexts including Moody expansion of children's religious radio drama, Mid-century religious-radio syndication, and Postwar family adventure, conservation and public-safety storytelling.
